_about: Provenance of Claude Code stream-json fixtures. None of these were captured from a real model run. Parser results on these files prove only that the parser handles these samples; real CLI output must be sampled locally (captured-live) before raising the evidence level.
author: Claude Code Cloud session (development agent), hand-written

placeholders.__SESSION_ID__: replaced by the stub with the --resume id or a fresh UUID
placeholders.__MODEL__: replaced by the stub with the --model value

assumed_fields: system/init: session_id, model, tools, mcp_servers, permissionMode, apiKeySource
result: subtype, is_error, num_turns, result, session_id, total_cost_usd, usage, permission_denials

permission_denied.jsonl.notes: combination of error subtype + denials is assumed

api_error_rate_limit.jsonl.notes: error text invented; only used to show heuristic (not structured) classification

unknown_events_no_usage.jsonl.notes: unknown event types and a result without usage

missing_result.jsonl.notes: stream ends without a result event

model_mismatch.jsonl.notes: init reports a model different from --model

resume_new_session.jsonl.notes: init reports a session id other than the requested --resume id

session_id_changed.jsonl.notes: init and result disagree on session id

unknown_terminal_subtype.jsonl.notes: unrecognized result subtype must never count as success
